assumed.assumption: SUM of total fits 64 bits in every group (checked at run time: the job raises if it does not; on_inferred="off" makes it an error)
assumed.message: SUM overflow: sum(total) (the job also checks it while it runs and raises if it happens; a bound on the column and on the rows of a group rules it out)

hints: SUM of `total`: bound it in `requires` of orders, for example `_.total <= 1_000_000_000` and `_.total >= -1_000_000_000`; then a group's sum fits 64 bits for up to 9,223,372,036 rows, and `sv.max_rows(9_223_372_036)` in `requires` of orders proves it, and so does `sv.rows_per([<grouping columns>], at_most=9_223_372_036)`; without a row bound, the job checks the sum as it runs
